name: A chant of the Hilali epic
about: "A few notes of the commencement of a chant" of a Sha'er, one of the poets of Cairo who recited the romance of Abu Zayd and the Banu Hilal from memory, playing a few notes on the one-stringed poet's viol after each verse: the viol's prelude, two lines of verse ("Ma-kalatu Khadra..."), and the prelude again. Notes as pitch:beats, quarter notes as beats.
